title: FULLSCREEN GATE AT ANY ZOOM
why: his report 10-27: the main PC build showed no fullscreen gate; his Chrome keeps 75 percent zoom for localhost, which made a normal window read as F11
now: the fullscreen gate opens in a normal window at any page zoom

edits.replacement: try{ var sc=window.screen, ow=window.outerWidth, iw=window.innerWidth, z=(ow>0&&iw>0)?ow/iw:0; if(sc&&sc.width>0&&sc.height>0&&z>0&&ow>=sc.width-2&&window.innerHeight*z>=sc.height-2) return true; }catch(_sz){}   /* v35.xx (cw-fszoom), HIS REPORT (2026-10-27): "the version on the main PC doesn't have my mandatory fullscreen pages but the version on the VM does". His Chrome keeps 75 percent zoom for localhost; inner sizes are CSS px and grow as zoom drops, screen is not, so a normal window passed as F11 and the gate never opened. The view height is put back in screen units (outer over inner width) before comparing. */
